products.title: CaliRides 105mm Turn 8 Wheels
products.description: In Stock: To check out how the Turn-8 wheels stack up against the Boosted 105's check this out: The CaliRides Turn 8 Wheels are the latest blend of technology and ingenuity. After several prototypes and rigorous testing, we developed our own unique formula that make our wheels feel even racier than before while maintaining a more direct feel than our predecessor. Our wheels cut through corners and feel insanely smooth through the straights. Developed in the same factory as the original Boosted 105's we are absolutely stoked to bring the next generation of wheels to you. Our focus was on feedback, one thing that is commonly lost on oversized wheels. By decreasing the outlining footprint, we increased rider sensitivity without compromising traction or comfort. Effortlessly ride over bumps and cracks while still being completely hooked up to the road. *CaliRides for Boosted Boards come with aluminum pulleys, front spacers, and bearings. (belts not included) *Also available for Evolve owners who want to mount our wheels. Evolve kits come complete with 38 tooth aluminum pulleys, bearings, and belts.
products.descriptionHtml:
In Stock:

To check out how the Turn-8 wheels stack up against the Boosted 105's check this out: 

The CaliRides Turn 8 Wheels are the latest blend of technology and ingenuity. After several prototypes and rigorous testing, we developed our own unique formula that make our wheels feel even racier than before while maintaining a more direct feel than our predecessor. Our wheels cut through corners and feel insanely smooth through the straights.  Developed in the same factory as the original Boosted 105's we are absolutely stoked to bring the next generation of wheels to you.  

Our focus was on feedback, one thing that is commonly lost on oversized wheels.  By decreasing the outlining footprint, we increased rider sensitivity without compromising traction or comfort.  Effortlessly ride over bumps and cracks while still being completely hooked up to the road. 

*CaliRides for Boosted Boards come with aluminum pulleys, front spacers, and bearings. (belts not included)

*Also available for Evolve owners who want to mount our wheels. Evolve kits come complete with 38 tooth aluminum pulleys, bearings, and belts.

The CNC aluminum frame provides strength and durability.MODES - ECO, SPORT, CORSA & CUST.• MENU NAVIGATION - Double tap the power button to enter the menu, tap it to enter into a setting, then double tap the deadman to go back.• MY BOARD - Check your board temperatures, battery data, product info and warnings.• RIDES - Check your recent & all time rides.• LIGHT SETTINGS - Change the board colors here!• AUTOMATED TRIGGER RESET - Follow the prompts in the remote for an easy reset. products.descriptionHtml:
The PHAZE remote has been designed to handle the toughest riding conditions as requested by our community!

Features

• CNC ALUMINIUM FRAME - We vigorously tested the remote ourselves in-line with military spec standards. The CNC aluminum frame provides strength and durability.
MODES - ECO, SPORT, CORSA & CUST.

• MENU NAVIGATION - Double tap the power button to enter the menu, tap it to enter into a setting, then double tap the deadman to go back.

• MY BOARD - Check your board temperatures, battery data, product info and warnings.

• RIDES - Check your recent & all time rides.

• LIGHT SETTINGS - Change the board colors here!

• AUTOMATED TRIGGER RESET - Follow the prompts in the remote for an easy reset. The remote will also prompt you when it needs resetting.

• SLEEP MODE - Both the remote and board will sleep after a several minutes without input. Simply hold the brake trigger down to wake up the remote and board.

Contents

  • 1 x Phaze Remote
  • 1 x Remote Case
  • 1 x Wrist strap
  • 1 x USB-C charging cable

  Compatibility

  • Bluetooth: Hadean, Renegade, Onirique, GTR and Stoke (Series 1 and 2)
  • Wifi: GT and GTX

Notes

  • Some features are not available with the GTR / Stoke Series 1, such as temperature readings, battery data, warnings, ride tracking and LED light control.
  • The features listed above are not available for the Wifi model.

products.title: Evolve GTR Series 2 Bamboo All Terrain
products.description: The NEW GTR Series 2 is the latest in tech and skate!The Series 2 introduces Bluetooth FOC control to the GTR, providing a new level of instant power with ultra-smooth acceleration and braking performance, placing the ultimate in intuitive riding control in your hands. Our lithium-ion Power Flex battery technology will provide you with a real-world range of up to 30km per charge with all terrain wheels, turning any road or path into the endless wave of your dreams. Now with powerful dual 6000W rated 6368 motors driving your adventure, smooth yet responsive performance is at the heart of this machine.Specs: DECK MATERIAL: 3-Ply Bamboo, 2-Ply Fibreglass DECK LENGTH: 96cm / 38inch WHEEL BASE (AXLE TO AXLE): Adjustable - 94cm to 91cm / 37 to 36 Inches TRUCKS: Evolve Super Carve Trucks - Forged/CNC & Cast components - 30.6cm (12") width, 8mm axles WHEELS: Evolve 7" pneumatic all terrain wheels. MOTOR: Dual 3000w-rated 6368 custom brushless sensored motors MOTOR CONTROLLER/ESC: Evolve Custom Dual-Motor Driver, FOC motor commutation, Bluetooth connection & adjustable acceleration curves BEARINGS: Evolve Precision Ceramic Bearings BATTERY: 14AH, 504WH, 10S4P, 18650 Cells RECHARGE: 4 - 5hrs REMOTE: Evolve Phaze remote with CNC aluminium-reinforced body RANGE: 19 miles TOP SPEED: 24mph MAX LOAD: 100kg / 220lb WEIGHT: 26.6lbs SUITABLE TERRAIN: Any terrain - Short Grass, dirt tracks, roads and footpaths. SLIDES: Offroad yes, not recommend on sealed surfaces HILLS: 25% + BRAKING: FOC regenerative braking with smooth engagement and adjustable brake curves AESTHETICS: Sophisticated traditional-styled bamboo deck. Concave from toe to heel for grip & comfort.

The NEW GTR Series 2 is the latest in tech and skate!

products.descriptionHtml:
The GTR Carbon Street takes the best features of old-school deck craftsmanship and merges them with cutting-edge technology to produce the ultimate electric skateboard.

Every improvement on the Series 2 sets a higher standard for personal transport, with no compromise being made towards achieving the ultimate riding experience regarding performance, durability and ride quality.

The combination of comfort, reliability, and intelligent technology means you can spend more time enjoying your journey no matter where you want to explore.

The Tech

The Series 2 introduces Bluetooth FOC control to the GTR, providing a new level of instant power with ultra-smooth acceleration and braking performance, placing the ultimate in intuitive riding control in your hands. Our lithium-ion Power Flex battery technology will provide you with a real-world range of up to 50km (31.1 miles) per charge, turning any road or path into the endless wave of your dreams. Now with powerful dual 3000W rated 6368 motors driving our made-in-USA Evolve 97mm inline race formula wheels, smooth yet responsive performance is at the heart of this machine.

The Ride

If you’ve skated before, you’ll appreciate the pop in this deck which puts you in the goldilocks zone for flex. The drop-through truck design allows wheelbase adjustment to dial in your ride and enjoy the low profile feel, just how you like it. Whether you’re into short and sharp or long and deep carving, our Carbon deck has a classic longboard vibe and will give you a harder feeling underfoot than its Bamboo counterpart.

Don’t mistake a smooth ride for a slow one… the GTR Carbon Street mode is like a cheetah unleashed! Super-fast and grippy, responsive yet nimble, and with the power to tear up any hill you can find. Corners will turn into apexes, open stretches into runways, and wide-open paths will make your list of favorite powder runs! This board will change the way you view the world and the paths you see in it.


Optional Extras

The Evolve GTR Carbon Street offers even more flexibility for the riding enthusiast than ever before, with 2 ports to power the Prism Strip under glow lighting and a new airline-friendly swappable battery option for those who want to take their board with them when traveling. Unlike other boards on the market, the Carbon GTR Street is compatible with our All Terrain Kit, which completely changes the feeling by opening up a world of new paths for you to explore.

The Remote

The all-new Phaze remote provides intuitive acceleration and braking through its dual trigger design and shrouds it in a robust aluminium frame. A CNC aluminium frame creates the backbone of the controller, strengthening it with the construction that aims to create a remote that meets the needs of the most hardcore riders. Its advanced user interface allows riders to track previous rides, view board diagnostics information, and control settings such as light colours/modes and speed limits. The Phaze is the most sophisticated remote in the electric skateboarding industry.

The App

The GTR Carbon Street offers more riding modes than ever before, with ECO, SPORT, and GTR built in as standard. Using the Explore By Evolve app, riders can adjust the total power, acceleration, and braking curves to perfectly suit their riding style. You can also track and share your rides, compete against the worldwide community of riders on the leader board and, of course, use the app for over-the-air updates for IOS and Android phones. Oh, and did we mention you can use the app to view diagnostic information and apply custom lighting mode to your Prism Strips?

products.description: Designed for a wide variety of mounting setups, the Universal Bar Mount securely holds your phone on the handlebars, stem, or frame of any bike, scooter, stroller, motorcycle, golf cart, and more. Silicone band attaches snugly to wide range of standard bar diameters and can be repositioned easily. Features an ultra-strong magnetic/mechanical mounting technology (called SlimLink) that grabs and locks your phone so effortlessly, it feels like magic. Remove your phone instantly with the push of a button. Easily switch between portrait and landscape alignment without removing your phone. The mounting head clocks in 32 discreet positions so you can position your phone level on any handlebar style. Quickly move this mount from one place to another, or remove it at the end of your ride in places where theft is a concern. Requires a Peak Design Case or Universal Adapter (sold separately).

products.description: A phone mount that is so beautiful, secure, and intuitive, that once you install it in your car, you'll feel like it was there from the start. That's because unlike flimsy, bulky plastic car mounts that stick out like sore thumbs, the Peak Design Car Mount is made from a beautiful machined/anodized aluminum and mounts directly to your dash or console via an ultra-durable 3M VHB pad. Ultra-strong MagSafe-compatible magnets hold your phone in place even during the most spirited driving‚ we call the mounting system SlimLink and it's so fast and secure, it borders on magic. Adjust viewing angle with a buttery-smooth aluminum ballhead. Car Mount's small footprint lets you mount your phone right where you want it without obstructing your view of the road. Available in standard or wireless charging models. With the charging model, the mount's magnetic connection system ensures perfect charging coil alignment every time. That means more consistent and efficient charging, and no more surprise battery outages.Requires a Peak Design Case or Universal Adapter (sold separately). Also works with MagSafe phones and phone cases. Charging may not be possible or optimal when using the Universal Adapter. Best results when attached to flat, hard, non-porous, non-textured surfaces.

products.title: Peak Design Universal adapter - Charcoal
products.description: Install this adhesive-backed adapter on the back of a 3rd party phone case to make nearly any phone compatible with Peak Design Mobile mounts and accessories. At just 2.5mm thick and wrapped in a beautiful weatherproof nylon canvas, the Universal Adapter is low-profile, aesthetically clean, and adheres with 3M VHB for an ultra-strong, ultra-durable connection. Like the Peak Design Everyday Case, the Universal Adapter has a brilliant magnetic/mechanical lock built right into it. We call this mounting technology SlimLink, and it's so fast and secure that it borders on magic. With this adapter on your 3rd party phone case, you can instantly connect to all Peak Design Mobile mounts and accessories. It even works with Apple MagSafe accessories, too. Adheres to smooth, non-textured, non-porous case materials like hard plastic and metal. Not recommended for soft or rubbery surfaces like silicone or leather. Installing directly on your phone is not recommended. Wireless charging may not be possible or optimal with adapter installed. This adapter contains magnets that may interfere with stylus accessories like the Samsung S-Pen. Not designed for tablets or folding/flip phones.

products.title: Super73 R Adventure Series
products.description: Get ready to take on any adventure with the redesigned R-Adventure Series electric bike from Super73. This cross-terrain conqueror comes standard with an 8-speed cassette, providing extra power to tackle even the gnarliest hills. The R Adventure's moto-inspired seat provides plenty of room to get into the perfect riding position, ensuring you stay comfortable even on your longest rides, regardless of terrain or conditions. Get ready to ride with power, comfort, and style with the R-Adventure Series from Super73.

products.title: Evolve Motor Plates
products.description: Replacement motor plate for Evolve Skateboards. Contents 1 x CNC Motor Plate Compatibility 3000w: Hadean and GTR2 1500w: Stoke 2, GTR1, Stoke 1, GT, GTX and GT ONE Installation Please find instructions below on Removing/Installing a Motor. Ensure the board is off. Remove the P-clips on the rear base plate by undoing the relevant nuts & bolts (not applicable to Hadean/GTR2). Disconnect the motor connectors. Remove the wheel, belt cover, belt and drive gear. Remove the four screws holding the motor in place and remove the motor from the board. The bolt head size is 1/8 inch, and the correct allen key is provided with every board. To install the new motor, repeat the steps in reverse. Be sure to set your belt tension correctly, and Contact us if you have questions.
products.descriptionHtml:
Replacement motor plate for Evolve Skateboards.  

Contents

  • 1 x CNC Motor Plate  

Compatibility

  • 3000w: Hadean and GTR2
  • 1500w: Stoke 2, GTR1, Stoke 1, GT, GTX and GT ONE

Installation

Please find instructions below on Removing/Installing a Motor.

  1. Ensure the board is off.
  2. Remove the P-clips on the rear base plate by undoing the relevant nuts & bolts (not applicable to Hadean/GTR2).
  3. Disconnect the motor connectors.
  4. Remove the wheel, belt cover, belt and drive gear.
  5. Remove the four screws holding the motor in place and remove the motor from the board. The bolt head size is 1/8 inch, and the correct allen key is provided with every board.
  6. To install the new motor, repeat the steps in reverse. Be sure to set your belt tension correctly, and Contact us if you have questions.

First, it features secure tiedown points along three edges, as well as strap slots. Next—and here’s the really smart part—it’s reversible. With the rail side up, it holds small packages securely. products.title: Super73 Battery Charger 54.6V 5A
products.description: A serious rider deserves a serious charge. This 5 amp battery charger is perfect for topping off your battery between rides and can reach a full charge faster than the 3 amp charger that comes standard with most SUPER73 ebikes. Using a fast charger will decrease the overall capacity of your battery quicker than using the standard 3 amp charger. To prolong the usable life of your battery, avoid using this charger as your main charger. This charger is best used when you are on the go and you should use your stock charger when charge time is not important. Includes: 5 amp battery charger, 3 pin connection Plugs into a standard 110-volt outlet Charge time may vary based on battery capacity The maximum range of a full charge depends on many variables: age of battery, slope, type of terrain, rider weight, speed, outside temperature, riding style, pedaling input, and tire pressure Dimensions L: 8in. W: 4in. products.title: Kinekt XR Active Suspension Seat Post
products.description: Kinekt suspension seat posts are the best in the biz and will make your JackRabbit ride as smooth as butter. Upgrade your JackRabbit with this seat post for a game-changing shock-absorber effect. Please note: this is a seat post and does not include a seat. We worked with the fine folks at Kinekt to create this seat post package designed specifically for JackRabbits. This seat post can support riders who weigh from 80-320lbs (36-145kg) and for taller riders from 5'2" to 6'6" (versus the 4'10" to 6'2" range of our stock seat post).The diameter of this seat post is 27.2mm (the same as our stock seat post) and the length is 420mm. This makes the seat able to go higher than our normal seat, which is useful when sitting on the Kinekt because the suspension causes the seat to lower when body weight is applied to it. If using this seat post with our rear basket accessory: the minimum rider height needs to be 5'4" in order for there to be enough room to attach the rear basket.

products.title: ZOOZ Custom Seats
products.description: ZOOZ custom seats are available in limited quantities. We will be regularly featuring new materials, colors, and patterns. Fits all Zooz Models (UU & UF) ZOOZ custom seats materials will vary in texture, grip and wear. Just like a pair of jeans, any seat material will have different characteristics and feel. In general, we use marine grade vinyl which is waterproof, mold and mildew resistant, UV treated and can withstand extreme heat and cold. We use bonded UV polyester and nylon thread. products.title: Evolve Project BMX Bike
products.description: $100 Deposit Pre-Order secures your Bike Reservation Shipping in April - LIMITED SUPPLY FIRST RELEASE Project BMX is a visionary quest to seamlessly blend electric innovation with authentic BMX geometry, crafting an unparalleled ride experience tailored for cyclists who need a little more cool from their bike. The ethos was to make no sacrifices to the ride feeling or look of traditional BMX - by using a nimble 24” design for agility and fluidity, and stealthy integration of the technology to maintain traditional aesthetics, Project BMX does just that. RIDES LIKE A BIKEMany eBikes place their motors and batteries in positions that are easiest and/or cheapest, with little regard to the effects on the rider experience. Frame geometry and weight distribution are pivotal in electric bike design, optimising rider comfort and bike handling. The carefully calculated angles and weight placement on Project BMX lower the centre of gravity, enhancing stability and control, especially at higher speeds or during tight maneuvers. This balance allows for a natural riding posture and facilitates intuitive control, improving the interaction between rider and machine.BatteryIntroducing a distinctive 36V battery system intricately designed to seamlessly integrate with the Project BMX drive system. The battery pack achieves an ideal harmony between range and power, discreetly nesting within the saddle to preserve the classic BMX cruiser frame aesthetic.This innovative system facilitates effortless battery swapping, empowering riders to expand their adventures with added range.Crafted in collaboration with VELO, the bespoke saddle seamlessly merges traditional adjustability, comfort, and innovation. It incorporates a built-in rail and lock mechanism, providing a secure home for the Evolve 36V Battery. Why Mid Drive?Using a mid-mounted motor in Project BMX goes far beyond maintaining aesthetics. This kind of motor offers substantial benefits over hub drive systems found on cheaper electric bikes.The mid-drive allows for optimal weight distribution for handling, a smoother and more natural pedal assist feeling, and eliminates the drawbacks of adding rotational mass to the rear wheel. They are also quieter, and being connected directly to the crank increases the motor’s efficiency to make the most of the bike’s range.KEEPING IT REALeBikes can be big, bulky, and a little bit ugly. Project BMX is a visionary quest to seamlessly blend electric innovation with authentic BMX geometry, crafting an unparalleled ride experience tailored for cyclists who need a little more cool from their bike. The ethos was to make no sacrifices to the ride feeling or look of traditional BMX - by using a nimble 24” design for agility and fluidity, and stealthy integration of the technology to maintain traditional aesthetics, Project BMX does just that.


RIDES LIKE A BIKE
Many eBikes place their motors and batteries in positions that are easiest and/or cheapest, with little regard to the effects on the rider experience. Frame geometry and weight distribution are pivotal in electric bike design, optimising rider comfort and bike handling. The carefully calculated angles and weight placement on Project BMX lower the centre of gravity, enhancing stability and control, especially at higher speeds or during tight maneuvers. This balance allows for a natural riding posture and facilitates intuitive control, improving the interaction between rider and machine.

Battery
Introducing a distinctive 36V battery system intricately designed to seamlessly integrate with the Project BMX drive system. The battery pack achieves an ideal harmony between range and power, discreetly nesting within the saddle to preserve the classic BMX cruiser frame aesthetic.
This innovative system facilitates effortless battery swapping, empowering riders to expand their adventures with added range.
Crafted in collaboration with VELO, the bespoke saddle seamlessly merges traditional adjustability, comfort, and innovation. It incorporates a built-in rail and lock mechanism, providing a secure home for the Evolve 36V Battery.

Why Mid Drive?
Using a mid-mounted motor in Project BMX goes far beyond maintaining aesthetics. This kind of motor offers substantial benefits over hub drive systems found on cheaper electric bikes.
The mid-drive allows for optimal weight distribution for handling, a smoother and more natural pedal assist feeling, and eliminates the drawbacks of adding rotational mass to the rear wheel. They are also quieter, and being connected directly to the crank increases the motor’s efficiency to make the most of the bike’s range.

KEEPING IT REAL
eBikes can be big, bulky, and a little bit ugly. We’ve painstakingly retained the iconic BMX spirit, seamlessly nestling the battery within the seat and embedding a potent mid-drive motor into the frame. The outcome? A sophisticated, perfectly balanced old-school BMX aesthetic that’s guaranteed to draw attention. Project BMX is crafted with premium Chromoly frame and fork tubing courtesy of TANGE. It’s not just a ride but a robust statement of quality.

Skyway Tuff Wheels
Skyway Tuff Wheels, proudly crafted in Baldwyn, Mississippi, embody American craftsmanship. Utilising a unique Zytel Nylon blend, they stand as the firmest plastic wheels.
With 45 years in the industry, Skyway is integral to retro BMX, seamlessly enhancing Project BMX's aesthetic. Our hub mount, compatible with a disk rotor on Skyway Tuffs, achieves a timeless appearance while enabling the use of a rear disk brake.

products.title: Evolve "Diablo" Bamboo 2 in 1
products.description: 2-IN-1 Set Up - Street and All Terrain ready!With this set up you’ll get everything you need - wheels, belts, gears, and covers - to transform a street board to an all-terrain or vice versa and ride it on any terrain. Easily swap out wheels in around 5 minutes. Unleash the ultimate in skating versatility with the Diablo Bamboo 2in, engineered to replicate the endless surf wave, or limitless snowboard run. Crafted for the thrill-seeker who craves both city-slicking and off-road adventures, this board transforms seamlessly between a street setup and an all-terrain beast with the flick of a switch. Picture yourself gliding effortlessly through city streets at sunset, then conquering rugged trails on a weekend escape—all on one board. Featuring dual 6374 3500W brushless motors, the Diablo Bamboo 2in1 reaches speeds up to 50 km/h, ensuring you can accelerate with lightning speed and climb hills with ease. Samsung's cutting-edge 50S battery technology delivers up to 80 km of range on street wheels - no more range anxiety. Enhanced by Evolve’s Super Carve 2 Trucks for unparalleled stability and precision and the eFOC 2.0 Motor Controller with Bluetooth connectivity for intuitive control, the Diablo is not just a board—it's the ultimate ride.

products.descriptionHtml:
GT3 Pro - In Stock

Free Helmet with purchase.

Meet the GT3 Series, the game-changer redefining what a SuperScooter can be. This isn't just an upgrade—it's a revolution. With a top speed of 50 mph and 0-30 mph acceleration in 3.9 seconds, this dual-motor marvel of the GT3 Pro dares to push the limits. A next-generation ride where performance and innovation meet to deliver an exhilarating experience.

Signature self-developed SegRange™ technology extends the range, enabling longer rides.

2160 Wh Battery with New 72V High-Voltage Platform. Experience the freedom of an extended ride.

  • Eco Mode Range[2]
    86 miles at 16 mph
  • Sport Mode Range[3]
    43 miles at 31 mph
  • Race Mode Range[4]
    31 miles at 50 mph

Key Features:

  • 7000W Motor Drive
  • 86-mile Maximum Range at 16 mph
  • 50 mph Maximum Speed
  • Dual Hydraulic Suspension: Front Adjustable Hydraulic Linkage & Rear Hydraulic Trailing-Arm
  • Smart TFT Display - Multifunction Interface
  • 3.9s Acceleration from 0 to 30 mph
  • 38% Climbing Slope
  • SegRide™ Stability Enhancement System

IPX6 Water Resistance Body[7]

The water resistance of GT3 Pro is IPX6. Its IPX6 rating ensures that you can continue your journey, even on wet conditions, without compromising on performance.

The battery pack is IPX 7.

Disturbance Resistance

Disturbance Resistance Equipped with an 80 mm large trailing distance combined with a precisely tuned stem angle and steering damping, enhancing the disturbance resistance, keeping the stable riding from unpredictable conditions.

Controllability

The curved handlebar provides a comfortable grip. Our design balances trailing distance and steering damping making the eKickScooter easy to control and smooth ride.

Skid-Resistance

SDTC 2.0 precisely manages each wheel's grip, instantly sending the necessary power needed for the surface you're on within 0.2 seconds to prevent skids and slips. With a motor control accuracy of 0.1Nm, the GT3 Pro easily handles slippery roads, rain or shine, ensuring your ride is always in control.

*TCS is turned off by default. You can activate it through the Segway Mobility app.

11-inch Tubeless Self-Sealing Tires

11-inch tubeless self-sealing tyres with 80mm width provides GT3 Pro's users with smoother and more stable rides on both city streets and rough paths. The self-sealing jelly layer inside the tires can withstand punctures without air leaking.

Battery

  • Capacity: 2160 Wh (72V)
  • Smart Battery Management System: Yes
  • Charging Time: Approx. 8 hours
  • Flash Charge: Yes

Motor

  • Power Output: 2 × 1700W
  • Maximum Power: 2 × 3500W
  • Traction Control System (TCS): Yes

Braking System

  • Brakes: Dual Hydraulic Brakes

Lighting

  • Headlights: High beam 14W / Low beam 5W
  • Rear Brake Light: Yes
  • Ambient Lights: No
  • Integrated Indicators: Yes (front and rear)

Tires

  • Type: Tubeless Pneumatic Tires with self-sealing jelly layer
  • Front Tire Size: 11 in (279 mm)
  • Rear Tire Size: 11 in (279 mm)

Connectivity & Smart Features

  • App Monitoring: Yes
  • Bluetooth: Yes
  • Segway AirLock: Yes
  • Apple Find My: Yes

Additional Features

  • Folding Mechanism: Easy folding (requires hands)

products.title: Evolve Skateboard Wall Rack
products.description: Save floor space with this wall-mounted Skateboard Rack for a sleek and modern storage solution for electric skateboards. Made of durable acrylic, it can hold boards up to 18kg with ease. The clear design makes for a discreet look when the board is not stored. Perfect for any skateboard enthusiast looking to keep their ride safe and easily accessible. Product Features: - Made from 10mm clear acrylic. - Rack capacity = 1 Skateboard ( max wheel size 7”) - Holds up to 18kg (39lbs) - Can be mounted to any wall material such as drywall, tile, stucco/plaster, wood, brick or concrete. Contents: 1 X Clear Acrylic Wall Stand 2 X Screws 2 X Masonry Plugs Notes: User must take care when installing the Wall Rack. Incorrect installation can lead to damage to property. Ensure they are mounting to a stud if installing to drywall.

products.description: Welcome to the final frontier of electric skateboarding technology.The Supersport lineage was born out of our obsession with finding and pushing limits. And doing away with compromises. It’s everything you love about the Lonestar, on steroids. Up until now, there was a choice to be made; to have top end speed, you sacrificed low end torque. If you had low end torque, that meant less top speed. Providing insane torque all across the power band while not sacrificing any top speed, the Supersport finally makes varying gear ratios irrelevant. This has never been accomplished before on a production board and only on very few DIY boards, all sporting our Stormcore 2.0. Meet the successor of the Prototipo... The Barrel™ - But we didn't stop there. Introducing the Barrel Supersport™. While maintaining the carvability and nimbleness of the original Barrel™, the all new Barrel Supersport™ boasts a massive 18S3P battery pack made of top of the line Molicel P45B 21700 cells. What does this mean, you ask? Well, you've basically got yourself a mini rocket ship that will tackle any hill, track, or terrain that you throw at it, and it's got the battery range to get you where you need to be with ease. The Barrel Supersport™ also comes with an optional 18S 8amp battery that will charge your board to 100% in approximately 1 hour. The Barrel Supersport™ features by default our new self-tensioning belt drive system. It shares the same bushings as the Hypertruck™ but as the Lite™ is narrower, it makes for a snappier, carvier ride even with the same duro bushings. How does it compare to the Proto you ask? products.title: Lacroix Boards Hypertruck Lonestar Blue, Falcon Gear Drive
products.description: Chiseled to hair splitting precision out of a huge brick of aerospace 7075 aluminum with a 5 axis CNC, the Hypertrucks™ were designed from the ground up by Lacroix™ in conjunction with Brad T. Miller (of RipTide™ Sports, a market leader in bushings technology) and an experienced DIY e-board mechanical CAD sorcerer (Pedro Paganini De Mio). The result is a 19 inch wide high precision Hypertruck™ with triple bearing axles (12mm and 15mm) made to hold a bearing in the wheel pulley, all of which self corrects speed wobbles. By their very design, the trucks are engineered to attenuate the wobbles, not amplify them. If they do start to occur, the trucks work so you don't get to that "oh sh*t" moment. On a medium-loose setup, if you start to feel wobbles around 33mph+, simply let off the throttle for a very slight moment and the trucks will automatically self correct and stabilize. After the magic happens, bend your knees and hit that throttle again.
products.descriptionHtml:
Chiseled to hair splitting precision out of a huge brick of aerospace 7075 aluminum with a 5 axis CNC, the Hypertrucks™ were designed from the ground up by Lacroix™ in conjunction with Brad T. The result is a 19 inch wide high precision Hypertruck™ with triple bearing axles (12mm and 15mm) made to hold a bearing in the wheel pulley, all of which self corrects speed wobbles.

By their very design, the trucks are engineered to attenuate the wobbles, not amplify them. If they do start to occur, the trucks work so you don't get to that "oh sh*t" moment. On a medium-loose setup, if you start to feel wobbles around 33mph+, simply let off the throttle for a very slight moment and the trucks will automatically self correct and stabilize.

After the magic happens, bend your knees and hit that throttle again.

These were all designed from the ground up by Ronald Horvart, a professional rim designer that made his mark in the JDM scene. The surface of the rims where the tires goes is 50mm wide (as opposed to 33mm on the MBS Rockstar hubs). This means the tires are nicely stretched to maximise the surface of contact. The inner rim for the wheels are all identical so if you want change design, you can simply purchase and swap out the outer rim. Complete set includes; 4 complete rims Titanium hardware (M5) either a 7075AL 72T pulley (compatible with all our belt drives) or a 7075AL precision CNC'd adapter (for Falcon™ gear drive) 4pcs custom CNC'd M12 nuts Rims only include; 4 pcs outer rim Titanium hardware (M5)
products.descriptionHtml:
The HyperRims™ are all CNC'd out of solid blocks of aerospace grade 7075AL. These were all designed from the ground up by Ronald Horvart, a professional rim designer that made his mark in the JDM scene.

The surface of the rims where the tires goes is 50mm wide (as opposed to 33mm on the MBS Rockstar hubs). This means the tires are nicely stretched to maximise the surface of contact.

The inner rim for the wheels are all identical so if you want change design, you can simply purchase and swap out the outer rim. 

Complete set includes; 

  1. 4 complete rims
  2. Titanium hardware (M5)
  3. either a 7075AL 72T pulley (compatible with all our belt drives) or a 7075AL precision CNC'd adapter (for Falcon™ gear drive) 
  4. 4pcs custom CNC'd M12 nuts

Rims only include; 

  1. 4 pcs outer rim 
  2. Titanium hardware (M5)

products.descriptionHtml:
Introducing the 4th generation GHOSTCAT F4X !

All-terrain fat tire electric bike specifically engineered to maneuver as a high-performance lightweight motorcycle inspired Dual Sport bike.  The F4X comes with a 60v/25ah battery, 55amp controller, 60v 2200W geared hub Hentach motor and premium KKE front fork 120mm travel and rear adjustable suspension to ensure a smooth all terrain ridding experience.  The F4X has a top speed of 40mph+, peak watts of 3,300W and 160nm+ of torque!

BEAST MODE (Warning: Recommended only for very experienced riders) controller programming now available as an aftermarket upgrade free of charge.  The BEAST mode programming dramatically increases the initial acceleration, low-end torque, top speed-and raises the thermal regulation temperature.  Send us your controller reference your original order # and will reprogram and ship back to you free of charge.  Turnaround time is typically 1-3 days to reprogram controller.  Expedited return options available fee will apply.

*THIS BIKE IS FOR PRIVATE OFF-ROAD USE ONLY (CA) please check local state e-bike regulations to determine proper e-bike classification.  The bike is delivered set to 20mph and 750W*

*FOR RIDERS 16 YEARS OF AGE AND OLDER*

*We reserve the right to make slight modifications to the bike to improve performance or make cosmetics changes* 

One year warranty on all major non-wear components

GHOSTCAT was carefully designed by selecting premium specifications to ensure a best-in-class riding experience for on-road and off-road adventures.

The lightweight aluminum alloy soft tail frame with adjustable premium KKE front fork with 120mm travel and rear adjustable suspension provides the ultimate shock absorbing system to ensure you have a smooth ride across all terrains.

This bike is powered by a high powered 60v 2200W nominal Hentach hub geared motor with peak watts of 3,300W, 160NM+ torque and 40mph+ top speed.

The bike is equipped with an 60v/25ah lithium battery giving you plenty of range 50+ miles PAS mode and 30-45 miles all electric mode.

The bike features an LCD display with the following driving modes, manual pedaling (1 gear), pedal assist mode (5 different settings) and pure electric.

This bike includes an extended seat for the ultimate comfort riding experience. Safety features include front and rear hydraulic brakes, LED front headlight and rear brake light.

products.description: 2-IN-1 Set Up - Street and All Terrain ready!With this set up you’ll get everything you need - wheels, belts, gears, and covers - to transform a street board to an all-terrain or vice versa and ride it on any terrain. Samsung's cutting-edge 50S battery technology delivers up to 80 km of range on street wheels - no more range anxiety. products.title: Macfox X2 Electric Mountain Ebike
products.description: The 750W motor, peaking at 1000W, offers the perfect balance of power and street legality. Experience torque-packed rides with 65Nm output and a top speed of 28mph, and you can enjoy powerful performance with confidence. According to laboratory tests conducted by our engineers, with an average rider weight and cruising steadily in second gear on paved roads—the X2 can achieve up to 45 miles of range with a single battery, and up to 90 miles with dual batteries. *MACFOX battery interfaces are fully compatible, allowing you to upgrade to higher-capacity batteries for extendedrange. However, please note that the selected battery capacity must not be lower than the standard battery to ensurebike performance and safety. Dual suspension smooths out every ride no matter the terrain. Equipped with both front and rear shock absorbers the X2 delivers unmatched comfort and control across city streets and rugged trails.

products.descriptionHtml:
Moto meets the Street!

Introducing the GEN 3 of our flagship model of electric bike, the Bullet. This new batch comes with Magura brakes, more mounting holes, a 5 amp quick charger, new kickstand, and new amp adjustment. This fat tire electric bike is expertly designed and tweaked to deliver the ultimate riding experience, with no compromises. As a Class-2 compliant bike, it meets the highest safety standards and regulations, while still providing unparalleled performance and style. Every detail of the Bullet has been tried and tested tirelessly through development by our team to offer a smooth and comfortable ride over any terrain. With the simple touch of your thumb, you'll feel the freedom to explore new horizons and conquer the terrains. Join the elite league of electric bike enthusiasts and experience the thrill of the Bullet.

P-51 ELECTRIC BIKES

P-51 is here to bridge the gap between a high-quality, full-suspension motorbike and a class-2 compliant e-bike. The moment you sit on our bike, you feel the difference. 

CLASS 2

20+ MPH, 28-32 MAX SPEED

DESIGNED IN HUNTINGTON BEACH, CALIFORNIA


20+ MPH, 28-32 MAX SPEED
40-60 MILE RANGE

Class 2 E bike 

750 WATT MOTOR

Tuned to P-51's unique riding style, our power unit delivers 750W nominally and a remarkable 1800W peak power, thanks to robust stainless steel gears that ensure reliability and outstanding torque

FRONT SUSPENSION
Suspension is at the core of P-51's mission to create a better bike. 27 inch downhill front forks offering 200mm of travel with adjustable compression and rebound

REAR SUSPENSION
Our patented frame design and precision-engineered angles deliver max suspension and travel. Enjoy smooth rides over the roughest terrains with 140mm of rear wheel travel, designed to master every bump with ease.

48 volt/20 AMP HOUR
48 volt - 20 AH lithium-ion battery using 21700 LG cells with an estimated range of 40+ miles on throttle only (varies due to riding style, rider weight, and riding terrain)

HYDRAULIC BRAKES
Magura MT5e 4-piston brake calliper forged in one piece has a high degree of rigidity, resulting in outstanding braking force and the best possible modulation.

BAJA FRONT LIGHT
Unlike most e-bikes, the P-51 features an integrated 12-volt system that powers a robust 1900 lumen LED front headlight, delivering exceptional nighttime visibility

LCD DISPLAY
Our LCD display screen provides riders with essential information like speed, odometer, voltage, battery level, trip meter, and run time. Plus, it offers two display modes

IDEAL RIDERS
Heights between 5'1-6'3
Commonly 13 years old and up
Max Weight 275 lbs

SIZE MAP
The P-51 Bullet is 72" from tire to tire, 36" from the ground to the seat, and 43" from the ground to the grips

products.title: Evolve Orangatang Dad Bod Street Wheels (105mm)
products.description: The Orangatang Dad Bod is the one of the most high-performance 100mm+ urethane skateboard wheel in existence and perfect for electric skateboarding. Four years of development, the new TrypoCore, and the tried-and-true Happy Thane formula combine to create the ultimate big-wheel experience at a shockingly light weight. Fast, Comfortable, & Functional — At 105mm tall, the Dad Bod provides exceptional roll speed, tons of momentum, and smooth rolling—it's kinda like cheating. The 57mm contact patch with its surface skin provides confident grip, while the subtly rounded edges help the wheels pass smoothly across pavement cracks. Extra Large Core — The brand new TrypoCore is much larger than the little brother found on the Caguama. This extra size means less urethane making the wheel feel very light and nimble for such a large diameter wheel. This core is compatible with any electric skateboard that can accommodate Orangatang Kegels, allowing for an even faster and smoother ride. Happy Thane Formula — The Dad Bod is poured in the proprietary Happy Thane formula for high roll speed, excellent traction, and smooth, predictable slides. SPECS Diameter: 105mm Width: 62mm Contact Patch: 57mm Bearing Seat: Offset Formula: Happy Thane Core: high-strength, high-stiffness, heat-resistant urethane Durometers: 80a for a great all-round ride Note: You must have Kegal gears to work with the core of the Dad Bod 105mm wheels

products.descriptionHtml:
Evolve Fusion

• The Best of Evolve, Now in One Board
• Power, Precision, and Portability 
• Built to Ride Everywhere

Born from Icons. Built for Everything.

Introducing the Fusion, a groundbreaking electric skateboard where the DNA of Evolve’s most iconic models converge. Crafted from the best of the Diablo, GTR, and Hadean series, the Fusion is the perfect balance of power, precision, and portability. Every element has been reimagined, refined, and fused to create the most versatile board in the Evolve lineup.

Power Meets Performance

At its core, the Fusion runs on a high-efficiency 12S 3P battery (648Wh) paired with the all-new EFOC 2.0 motor controller, delivering seamless acceleration, enhanced thermal management, and a ride that’s as responsive as it is exhilarating. The Fusion Street Board has a top speed of 31 mph, with a max range of up to  37 miles, and hill-climbing torque that laughs in the face of steep grades.

Decked Out in Style

Aesthetics meet engineering in the Fusion’s premium bamboo deck, a compact, lightweight design with a rich, natural finish and precision laser-etched detailing. The deck isn’t just stunning, it’s versatile too. Riders can choose between two battery configurations: the 12S 3P (648Wh) for maximum range, or the 12S 2P (432Wh) for a lighter, more agile setup, tailored to how you ride.

Compact. Capable. Clean.

Weighing in at just 27.5 lbs, the Fusion proves that high performance doesn’t have to be heavy. With its streamlined profile and compact footprint, it’s easy to carry, store, and ride, without compromising on specs or strength.

Custom Gold Standard

Every Fusion rolls out with a premium setup straight from the box. You get Evolve’s signature Gold SuperCarve 2.0 trucks, designed for ultimate stability and control at speed. Paired with tanwall all-terrain tyres and gold precision bearings, this board doesn’t just ride smooth, it looks the part too. It’s our cleanest factory build yet, with style and substance in every detail.

Everything You Need, Nothing You Don’t

Dual high-torque motors for effortless acceleration
Evolve’s smart remote for buttery-smooth control and deep customization
Also available in all-terrain and 2in1 configurations.
Durable, responsive, and ready to ride out of the box
From your daily commute to weekend carves, Fusion ticks every box. It’s powerful, lightweight, stunning to look at, and above all, built to ride. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just stepping into the world of electric skateboarding, the Fusion is the only board you'll ever need.

DECK MATERIALS: 3-Ply Bamboo, 2-Ply Fibreglass
DECK LENGTH: 96cm / 38inch
WHEEL BASE: Adjustable - 94cm to 91cm / 37 to 36 Inches
TRUCKS: Evolve Supercarve 2 - Forged/CNC  - Gold Finish
WHEELS: Evolve custom-formula 97mm, 76a urethane wheels, made in USA - Compatible with Evolve All-Terrain Conversion Kits.
MOTOR: Dual 6368 3000w rated  (6000w Total) custom brushless sensored motors
MOTOR CONTROLLER / ESC: EFOC 2 - Evolve Custom 50V, 200A Dual-Motor Driver, FOC motor commutation, Bluetooth Connection.
BEARINGS: Evolve Gold Precision Bearings
BATTERY: 12S3P 50.4v 648Wh 15AH Samsung 50S (Also available in a 12S2P battery setup)
RECHARGE: 4 hrs
REMOTE: Evolve Phaze remote with CNC aluminium-reinforced body
WEIGHT: 12.5 kg (27.5 lbs)
RANGE: Up to 60km (37 miles) (Street Wheels)
TOP SPEED: 50km/h (31 mph) (Street Wheels)
MAX LOAD: 120 kg (265 lbs)
SUITABLE TERRAIN: Sealed surfaces- asphalt & concrete roads & footpaths
SLIDES: Yes
HILLS: 35% + gradient.
BRAKING: EFOC2 regenerative braking, super smooth with adjustable brake and acceleration curves using the Explore APP
AESTHETICS: Sophisticated traditional-styled bamboo deck. Concave from toe to heel for grip & comfort.
LIGHTS: Front and rear LED lights. User-customisable control via remote and Evolve app.

NOTE – Please reach out to us if you are looking for a 12S2P battery option for your Fusion.

Evolve Fusion

• The Best of Evolve, Now in One Board
• Power, Precision, and Portability 
• Built to Ride Everywhere

Born from Icons. Built for Everything.

Introducing the Fusion, a groundbreaking electric skateboard where the DNA of Evolve’s most iconic models converge. Crafted from the best of the Diablo, GTR, and Hadean series, the Fusion is the perfect balance of power, precision, and portability. Every element has been reimagined, refined, and fused to create the most versatile board in the Evolve lineup.

Power Meets Performance

At its core, the Fusion runs on a high-efficiency 12S 3P battery (648Wh) paired with the all-new EFOC 2.0 motor controller, delivering seamless acceleration, enhanced thermal management, and a ride that’s as responsive as it is exhilarating. The Fusion Street Board has a top speed of 31 mph, with a max range of up to  37 miles, and hill-climbing torque that laughs in the face of steep grades.

Decked Out in Style

Aesthetics meet engineering in the Fusion’s premium bamboo deck, a compact, lightweight design with a rich, natural finish and precision laser-etched detailing. The deck isn’t just stunning, it’s versatile too. Riders can choose between two battery configurations: the 12S 3P (648Wh) for maximum range, or the 12S 2P (432Wh) for a lighter, more agile setup, tailored to how you ride.

Compact. Capable. Clean.

Weighing in at just 27.5 lbs, the Fusion proves that high performance doesn’t have to be heavy. With its streamlined profile and compact footprint, it’s easy to carry, store, and ride, without compromising on specs or strength.

Custom Gold Standard

Every Fusion rolls out with a premium setup straight from the box. You get Evolve’s signature Gold SuperCarve 2.0 trucks, designed for ultimate stability and control at speed. Paired with tanwall all-terrain tyres and gold precision bearings, this board doesn’t just ride smooth, it looks the part too. It’s our cleanest factory build yet, with style and substance in every detail.

Everything You Need, Nothing You Don’t

Dual high-torque motors for effortless acceleration
Evolve’s smart remote for buttery-smooth control and deep customization
Also available in all-terrain and 2in1 configurations.
Durable, responsive, and ready to ride out of the box
From your daily commute to weekend carves, Fusion ticks every box. It’s powerful, lightweight, stunning to look at, and above all, built to ride. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just stepping into the world of electric skateboarding, the Fusion is the only board you'll ever need.

products.descriptionHtml:
NEW: Bert Touch - NOT RETURNABLE for obvious reasons

Got the dreaded RLOD (Red Light of Death)? The all-new Bert Touch makes it simple to check and balance your battery cells, clearing RLOD and getting your board back on the road.


Why Bert Touch?

  • Fixes most XR batteries (not compatible with SR or Rev yet)
  • Balances cells automatically — just plug it in and let it work
  • Simple to use: disconnect your battery from the motor controller, plug into Bert, and follow the on-screen instructions

How it Works

RLOD means your battery cells are out of sync and need to rebalance. With Bert Touch plugged in, simply leave your battery connected and let it run. Sometimes balance is restored in minutes, other times it may take weeks — it depends on how far out of sync the cells are.


⚠️ Important: If your battery has been completely dead for years, it’s likely too far gone to recover.

 

Risk-Free Option
Not sure about spending $250 if your cells can’t be rebalanced? We get it. That’s why we offer a Single Battery Repair Service:

  • Send in your battery
  • We’ll clear your RLOD (if possible) and cover round-trip shipping
  • If it can’t be fixed, we’ll either return it to you or recycle it responsibly

CLICK HERE FOR BOOSTED BATTERY SERVICE

Kit includes: 1 BERT Module, a set of ChopSticks and a power cable.  

👉 If you’re unsure whether your board is a candidate for Bert Touch, send us a quick video of your battery error code and we’ll confirm before you buy. Please note, if you send us a battery that is not showing the RLOD battery error, we will not be able to diagnose or fix it for you.

products.description: Bert Touch Battery Restore Service Don’t want to buy a new Bert module? Try a one-time recovery of your battery with us instead. How It Works Step 1 – Send Us a VideoTake a video of your battery lights when you first turn it on and email it to support@boostedusa.com.Please also let us know how long it has been since the battery was working properly. We’ll review your video and let you know if your battery has the Red Light of Death (RLOD) and whether it’s a good candidate for recovery. Step 2 – Purchase the ServiceThe service costs $100 + shipping your battery to us. Step 3 – Ship Your Battery & ESCSend us your Battery and ESC controller (the ESC is the component in front of the motors). This will require removing the rear trucks and, depending on the board, possibly the front trucks as well. Please record your batteries serial number (Located on the back of the battery and begins with a B), and ship via a traceable method to: Boosted USA821 Francisco Blvd ESan Rafael, CA 94901415-785-8428 What’s Included Full diagnostic evaluation Attempted RLOD Error Cleared and Battery Recovery Return shipping of your ESC and/or battery (covered by us) Responsible battery disposal if recovery is not possible Important Notes This service is currently only for Boosted Extended Range Batteries showing the RLOD error. Extended Range Batteries without RLOD cannot be repaired. We are working on solutions for Rev and SR batteries in the future. This is not a guaranteed repair. Some battery cells may be too damaged or imbalanced to recover, or there may be connection issues that cannot be resolved. If Your Battery Cannot Be Repaired If recovery is not possible, you may choose to: Have your battery returned to you (return shipping is covered by us), or Have us responsibly dispose of it at no additional cost. Please Note: If your battery cannot be recovered, the $100 service fee is non-refundable, as it covers the time and labor involved in diagnostic testing and recovery attempts. If you have any questions, please contact us before purchasing.

Bert Touch Battery Restore Service

Don’t want to buy a new Bert module? Try a one-time recovery of your battery with us instead.

How It Works

Step 1 – Send Us a Video
Take a video of your battery lights when you first turn it on and email it to support@boostedusa.com.
Please also let us know how long it has been since the battery was working properly.

We’ll review your video and let you know if your battery has the Red Light of Death (RLOD) and whether it’s a good candidate for recovery.

Step 2 – Purchase the Service
The service costs $100 + shipping your battery to us.

Step 3 – Ship Your Battery & ESC
Send us your Battery and ESC controller (the ESC is the component in front of the motors).

This will require removing the rear trucks and, depending on the board, possibly the front trucks as well.

Please record your batteries serial number (Located on the back of the battery and begins with a B), and ship via a traceable method to:

Boosted USA
821 Francisco Blvd E
San Rafael, CA 94901
415-785-8428

What’s Included

  • Full diagnostic evaluation

  • Attempted RLOD Error Cleared and Battery Recovery

  • Return shipping of your ESC and/or battery (covered by us)

  • Responsible battery disposal if recovery is not possible

Important Notes

  • This service is currently only for Boosted Extended Range Batteries showing the RLOD error.

  • Extended Range Batteries without RLOD cannot be repaired.

  • We are working on solutions for Rev and SR batteries in the future.

  • This is not a guaranteed repair. Some battery cells may be too damaged or imbalanced to recover, or there may be connection issues that cannot be resolved.
